data_nature: synthetic CSV/ZIP; real PostgreSQL and Fuseki; not CAD import performance

environment.background_load: Existing formal services may remain active; no concurrent native regression permitted

method.first_pass: first import at each size; OS caches were not cleared
method.warm: new content and distinct release for every repeat; no import deduplication
method.query_export_release: last successful release per size, fixed for all requests
method.queue: submit_job return to claim_job return, includes claim SQL; negative overlap clamped to zero
method.import_processing: claim return through verified SQL and RDF readback; publication excluded
method.publication: build_navigation start through publish_release return, including file verification and registration
method.atomic_activation: complete publish_release SQL transaction including connect, locks, release status, state update and commit
method.export: complete public ponds class only, all pages; wall time includes HTTP, parsing, validation; http_seconds also supplied
method.p95: nearest rank; successful samples only, all failures counted; small N cannot establish capacity
